rules: Inherit the established dark Yotta Operate, HUD and Nuxt UI system.
Panels are independently managed or plugin-owned; workflows use typed references.
Workflow completion ends waiting subscriptions, not the panel or its editable controls.
Separate panel status, latest writer state and waiting information.
Managed buttons require a matching waiting subscription; switches and inputs remain usable without one.
Manager previews do not dispatch live behavior; plugin definitions are read-only.
Workflow default selection and node overrides select existing typed resources.
Preserve focused drafts and reader scroll position during live updates.
Panel preview starts expanded in a persistent settings card and never dispatches behavior.
Default-panel settings live beside the automation target in the always-visible canvas toolbar, including blank workflows.
Nodes inherit by default; an explicit checkbox enables individual panel overrides.
Use panel is a legacy-compatible node hidden from new-node menus, not a prerequisite.
Manager retains SettingsSection and SettingsView.css and reuses the shared launcher arrangement table.
Names, icons and initial values edit inline in stable columns; narrow tables scroll horizontally.
Multi-selection drag and bulk destination movement preserve relative row order.
Bulk editing offers compatible common fields; row More holds delete and top/bottom movement.
Do not restore row accordions or permanent up/down controls.
The 40px selection toolbar replaces column headers without shifting rows; it includes select all and clear selection.
Layout preview defaults open in a settings card; the card remains when collapsed.
